name: Deliverance Ministry
overview: Deliverance ministry, as revealed in Scripture, centers on God's power to rescue and protect His people from trouble, fear, and bondage. The Psalms affirm that the Lord is a refuge who surrounds the faithful with songs of deliverance and dispatches His angelic presence to guard them. Isaiah highlights the Spirit-anointed mission to proclaim freedom to captives and healing to the brokenhearted, while Hosea recalls God's historic deliverance of Israel through prophetic intervention. This ministry is rooted in a heavenly Father's care, inviting believers to approach Him in prayer with reverence and trust.
